coaching.headline: We out-killed them 24-16 and won the majors ledger 25-21, and still lost — our four won fights cashed one prize while their three won fights cashed all three.
coaching.team: We kept winning moments and banking nothing. The 19.5 teamfight went 5-1 at our Fangtooth and nothing followed it; the conversion sheet shows won fights at 2.2, 10.1 and 19.5 all left on the table, and towers finished 5-9 against us. Meanwhile every fight we dropped got cashed: the 0-2 at their outer tower at 15.7 — started while the offlane was pinned in a losing lane and the jungler, ahead, never rotated — cost our own outer tower at 16, and the 41.4 fight went 0-2 with a 5v4 man advantage right before the Core fell at 42. One build note for the whole team: we did carry anti-heal (three Tainted pieces), but by the gold model they arrived at minutes 34-41 while Narbash healed 70,180 across the game — those buys belong in the mid-game, not the last slots.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Minute 30.9 to the end. Kallari was caught alone by Yurei at 30.9 and Orb Prime went over at 31.5; the 32-34 window added Genesis Core and Primal Fangtooth. The 39.1 loss at our Orb Prime pit was genuinely a trade — we took Orb Prime in that same window — but they answered with Primal Fangtooth at 40, and at 41.4 we lost the final fight 0-2 while up a body 5v4, with the support alive and ahead in lane but absent and the offlane pinned. The Core fell at 42.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Dekker was the team's eyes and its cleanest scoreline — 2/1/12 with 25 wards and a single death in 42 minutes. The lesson sits in the endgame: at 39.1 and 41.4 the macro read has Dekker alive and ahead in lane while the deciding fights went 0-2 — shove the wave and rotate, and those become a numbers advantage. And the Tainted Scepter that answers Narbash's 70,180 healing was the sixth item, around minute 41 by the gold model; against a heal-stacking support it wants to be bought several slots earlier.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Sevarog gave the team its only frontline and soaked a team-high 64,915 mitigated on 2 deaths. The paper read said Terra takes over late; the scoreline disagreed — Sevarog finished 2/2/5 to Terra's 1/4/5, and he killed her at 6.6. The team-level note is that two losing fights (15.7 and 41.4) were started while Sevarog was pinned across the map — the right call is to fight where the frontline can arrive. On items, Fire Blossom was the one missing core piece; Elafrost and Claw of Hermes took its slots.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Kallari was the engine early — first blood on Terra at 2.2 and 31124 hero damage — but three of his six deaths sat right before enemy prizes: caught by Yurei at 30.9 ahead of their Orb Prime at 31.5, down at 39.1 before Primal Fangtooth, and in the 41.4 fight before the Core. Yurei got him three times in all (6.7, 26.4, 30.9), and two wards all game is the cheapest fix on a stealth assassin who dies to any crowd control: ward before crossing, and only go in when the pick is truly alone. With a 3-physical enemy comp, one armor piece also belonged in the build — the film flags that none was bought.

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 506 healing a minute, more than 98% of Terra offlane players this patch.
Unstoppable Force at rank 3: 105s base, about 85.4s by the end (19% shorter) from 23 ability haste: Tainted Guard 8, Elafrost 15.
6 takedowns (1 kills, 5 assists) fed: Cannibalism (minor).
Terra dealt 26,517 hero damage, 22% of their team's, with +50 physical power from items.
Overlord (item): On Successful Basic Attack: Deal (+1%) Damage. Deal (+30%) (+2.5%) Damage around the Target. Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Elafrost (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 70 (+2%) Damage On-Hit around the Target. Slows by 35% for 1.5s. Damage is increased by 60% against Monsters.
Iron Resolve (augment): Wild Rush grants 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Damage Reduction while it is Channeling.

Sustain: 8% heal and shield power; Tainted Guard: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.; Transference: Upon Shields expiring: 50% of its remaining value is restored as Health over 3s. Reduced to 25% for Ally Shields.; 21,237 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1980 health, +198 physical armor, +45 magical armor; took 76,873 damage, mitigated 106,402, died 4 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Tainted Guard, Elafrost.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Terra killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Dekker, Sevarog, Lt. Belica. We killed Terra 4 times.
Copy it? Krix (Voracity + Cannibalism): 45.8% in 441 Terra offlane games, below the hero's 47.8%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
